title: 第十七章 小南包子店第十八章 坏人陈孝正
content_zh:
最新网址：王跃在步行四处的闲逛，刚巧又看到了那个卖包子的小姐姐，还是那辆小推车，这次却换到了街道的这头，离学校又远了一些，王跃猜想可能她被驱赶了吧。
王跃回头，看到几步远有一个十几平的小店门上贴着的转租出售的告示，又回头看了看小姐姐的包子摊位。于是他走到门店门口，把告示揭了下来。
十二平的小店，花了3万多，店主比王跃还积极，不到一周房本就到了王跃手里。王跃不知道是贵了，还是便宜了。
拿到店铺房产证的当天，他就找到了小姐姐。
“我是王跃，这学校建筑工程学院土木工程系的学生！”王跃趁包子铺没人的功夫，给小姐姐打招呼。
“你是小北同学啊？小北在学校怎么啦！”小姐姐一听王跃的介绍，突然就紧张起来。
“小姐姐，我是小北同学，不过和她不是太熟悉，你和她认识？”王跃被对面女孩的激动情绪弄的一头雾水。
小姐姐一看不是小北的事情，就松了一口气，但是马上又有些紧张，似乎有些话，但是又欲言又止。
王跃看这情况，实在搞不太懂小姐姐在想啥。于是单刀直入的说，“是这样的，那边那个12平的小店铺被我买下了，但是我没时间经营，就想和你合伙做生意。”
小姐姐更慌了，那么多钱买了个房子，又不自己做生意，难道他想……
王跃看小姐姐那一脸防备的样子，知道今天是谈不下去了。想到她认识朱小北，就还是耐心的解释，“我就是看好这里的环境，觉得房价肯定会继续涨，就想买了做投资。但是也不能空着是吧，所以想和你合伙做生意。这样吧。这是我宿舍电话，你呢，可以找小北核实下我身份！咱们再谈行不。”
王跃就以退为进的写下了自己的宿舍电话后就走了，留下呆愣愣的小姐姐。
王跃是潇潇洒洒的走了，却是给朱小北姐妹增加了很多烦恼。
朱小南当天晚上就联系了朱小北，而朱小北正和宿舍的人谈论今天的社团招新。郑微加入了围棋社，朱小北更是加入了一堆乱七八糟的社团。
就在大家热火朝天的正在讨论今天的新鲜事的时候，宿舍电话响了。
大家都以为是郑微的，所以都没有动，只有郑微接起了电话，才知道是找朱小北的。
朱小北听到电话后，原来笑嘻嘻的表情立马变了颜色，大家感觉不对，于是都放下了嬉闹。
第二天上午前两节没有课，王跃难得的睡了一个懒觉。第三节上课的时候，王跃宿舍一起去教室，结果发现原来他们坐的位置，被人占了。
看到王跃进教室，郑微老远的给他招手，王跃看到紧挨着她的从原来的阮莞换成了朱小北，就大致明白了什么意思。
看到王跃几个人走了过去，朱小北他们四个往里挪了四个位置。而王跃顺势就紧挨着郑微坐了过去。

“王跃，那小店真是你买的？”郑微看王跃这么乖觉，就立马单刀直入。
“给！”王跃没说啥，就从抱着的几本书中间抽出一个红色的本本，递给了郑微，“保密！”
“好的！好的！”郑微拿起红本本，摆在朱小北面前，几个人就那么围着看，一边看，还一边小声的嘀嘀咕咕的。
content_en:
Latest website: Wang Yue was walking around and happened to see the girl selling steamed buns again. It was the same cart, but this time it was at this end of the street, further away from the school. Wang Yue guessed that she might have been driven away.
Wang Yue turned around and saw a sublease and sale notice posted on the door of a small shop with an area of ​​more than ten square meters a few steps away. He then looked back at the young lady's bun stall. So he walked to the door of the store and took down the notice.
The 12-square-meter shop cost more than 30,000 yuan, and the owner was more proactive than Wang Yue. Within a week, the money for the house was in Wang Yue's hands. Wang Yue didn't know whether it was expensive or cheap.
The day he got the store's real estate certificate, he found the young lady.
"I'm Wang Yue, a student from the Civil Engineering Department of the School of Architecture and Engineering of this school!" Wang Yue took advantage of the fact that the bun shop was empty to greet the young lady.
"Are you Xiaobei's classmate? What's wrong with Xiaobei at school?" The young lady suddenly became nervous when she heard Wang Yue's introduction.
"Miss, I'm Xiaobei's classmate, but I'm not very familiar with her. Do you know her?" Wang Yue was confused by the excitement of the girl opposite.
When the young lady saw that it was not Xiaobei's fault, she breathed a sigh of relief, but immediately became a little nervous. She seemed to have something to say, but she hesitated.
Seeing this situation, Wang Yue really couldn't understand what the young lady was thinking. So he said straight to the point, "It's like this. I bought the 12-square-meter small shop over there, but I don't have time to run it, so I want to do business with you in partnership."
The young lady was even more panicked. He bought a house with so much money and didn't start his own business. Could it be that he wanted to...
Seeing the defensive look on the young lady's face, Wang Yue knew that they couldn't continue talking today. Thinking that she knew Zhu Xiaobei, she patiently explained, "I am optimistic about the environment here and feel that housing prices will continue to rise, so I want to buy it for investment. But I can't leave it empty, so I want to do business with you. Let's do this. This is my dormitory phone number. As for you, you can ask Xiaobei to verify my identity! Can we talk about it later?"
Wang Yue took a step back and wrote down his dormitory phone number and left, leaving the young lady stunned.
Wang Yue left in a carefree manner, but it caused Zhu Xiaobei sisters a lot of trouble.
Zhu Xiaonan contacted Zhu Xiaobei that night, and Zhu Xiaobei was talking to people in the dormitory about today's club recruitment. Zheng Wei joined the Go club, and Zhu Xiaobei joined a bunch of messy clubs.
Just when everyone was discussing today's news enthusiastically, the dormitory phone rang.
Everyone thought it belonged to Zheng Wei, so they didn't move. Only when Zheng Wei answered the phone did they know it was for Zhu Xiaobei.
After Zhu Xiaobei heard the call, his smiling expression immediately changed color. Everyone felt something was wrong, so they all stopped playing.
There were no classes in the first two periods of the next morning, so Wang Yue took a rare nap. During the third period of class, Wang Yue went to the classroom together from his dormitory, only to find that the seat they were sitting in was occupied by someone else.
Seeing Wang Yue enter the classroom, Zheng Wei waved to him from afar. Wang Yue saw that the person next to her had been replaced by Zhu Xiaobei instead of Ruan Guan, and he roughly understood what it meant.
Seeing Wang Yue and others walking over, Zhu Xiaobei and the others moved four positions inside. Wang Yue took advantage of the situation and sat next to Zheng Wei.
"Wang Yue, did you really buy that store?" Zheng Wei saw that Wang Yue was so obedient, so she immediately went straight to the point.
"Here!" Wang Yue didn't say anything, but took out a red notebook from among the books he was holding and handed it to Zheng Wei, "Keep it secret!"
"Okay! Okay!" Zheng Wei picked up the red notebook and placed it in front of Zhu Xiaobei. Several people just stood around and looked at it, muttering quietly while reading.
